BIT_IDCODE_VERIFY.Name: IDCODE Verify
BIT_IDCODE_VERIFY.Description: This test verifies silicon device ID code. The test failure means it is not a compatible device.

BIT_CLOCKS_OUTPUT_TEST.Name: Clocks Output Test
BIT_CLOCKS_OUTPUT_TEST.Description: This test verifies the clock output frequencies by measuring the clocks at the device-under-test with clock counters. The test will fail in case the clock settings are different than default values.

BIT_DDRMC_1_CAL_TEST.Name: DDRMC_1 Cal Test
BIT_DDRMC_1_CAL_TEST.Description: This test verifies FPGA-based DDR memory controller 1 successfully completed calibration.

BIT_DRAM_MEM_TEST.Name: DRAM Mem Test
BIT_DRAM_MEM_TEST.Description: This test verifies DRAM access by 8MB write, read and compare with cache on/off. The patterns used are 0s, 1's, 0xAAAA5555, row, col, bank.

BIT_LEDS_TEST.Name: LEDs Test
BIT_LEDS_TEST.Description: This test verifies board LEDs (LED1 - LED4). Look at the image displayed to locate LEDs on the board. The test takes about 30 secs. Notice the LEDs blinking.

Level 0.Instruction:
1- Connect to the 1st com port, baud rate 115200, to see output of the test.
2- Look for LEDs (LED1 - LED4) on the board.
3- After clicking 'OK' observe LEDs blinking, then turn on/off in sequence.
4- Click 'OK' when you are ready.
5- Image location=270,170, size=63,32.

Level 1.Instruction:
1- Did you see the LEDs blinking and sequencing?
2- Click 'Pass' if you observed it.
3- Image location=270,170, size=63,32.

BIT_BUTTONS_TEST.Name: Buttons Test
BIT_BUTTONS_TEST.Description: This test verifies push buttons (SW6, SW9). See the buttons on the board as displayed on the image to locate buttons. The test waits for about 50 secs to press buttons. The test fails if the buttons are not pressed in the order within the time limit.

Level 0.Instruction:
1- Connect to the 1st com port, baud rate 115200, to see output of the test.
2- Look for Push Buttons SW9 (Center) and SW6 (West) on the board.
3- After clicking 'OK' press Push Buttons SW9, followed by SW6, and followed by any button (SW6 or SW9).
4- Click 'OK' when ready.
5- Image location=206,89, size=63,32.

BIT_DIP_SWITCHES_TEST.Name: DIP Switches Test
BIT_DIP_SWITCHES_TEST.Description: This test verifies DIP switches (SW8). Look at the image displayed and locate the DIP switches on the board. The test waits for about 60 secs to toggle lower 4 DIP switches. The test fails if the DIP switches are not toggled in the order within the time limit.

Level 0.Instruction:
1- Connect to the 1st com port, baud rate 115200, to see output of the test.
2- Look for DIP switches (SW8) on the board
3- After clicking 'OK' turn On and then turn Off lower 4 DIP Switches (1 - 4)
4- Click 'OK' when you are ready.
5- Image location=465,300, size=40,63.
